text: Why would my monthly bill be higher than last month?
key_points: names plausible causes (plan change, usage/overage, promo ending, proration, taxes) or says to compare statements; offers human review

text: I was charged twice this month. What should I do?
key_points: acknowledges; says a duplicate charge is reviewed/refunded by a human; does not claim it is fixed

text: Where do I change the card that my plan is billed to?
key_points: points to account/billing/payment settings to change the payment method

text: What happens if I pay my bill a few days late?
key_points: mentions a possible late fee or service impact and suggests paying or contacting billing; no invented amounts

text: Can I get a refund for a month I didn't use?
key_points: says refund requests go to human review/approval; does not approve it

text: How do I download my past invoices?
key_points: points to the account/billing area for invoice history or downloads

text: Is there a discount if I pay yearly instead of monthly?
key_points: says annual plans may be discounted or to check plans/pricing; no invented percentages presented as fact

text: My Wi-Fi keeps dropping every few minutes. How can I fix it?
key_points: restart router/modem, check placement/interference, update firmware, or test a wired connection

text: Every time I tap Settings the app closes by itself.
key_points: update the app, restart the device, clear cache, or reinstall; offers escalation

text: What's the way to factory reset my router?
key_points: hold the reset button (about 10-30 s) and warns settings are erased

text: My internet is slow in the evenings. Why?
key_points: peak-time congestion or many devices; suggests a speed test, wired test or restart

text: Since I changed my password the login page keeps rejecting me.
key_points: check caps/typos, use password reset, clear cache, check the account is not locked

text: How can I enable 2FA on my account?
key_points: security/account settings, enable 2FA, choose an authenticator or SMS

text: The modem lights are blinking orange. What does that mean?
key_points: usually no connection/sync or an error; restart, check cables, contact support if it persists

text: How do I change my Wi-Fi password?
key_points: log in to the router admin page or app, wireless settings, set a new password

text: What are your support hours?
key_points: does not invent specific hours as fact; says to check the website/contact page or offers human help

text: How do I cancel my subscription?
key_points: account/subscription settings or contacting support; does not claim it is cancelled

text: Is it possible to put my plan on hold for two months?
key_points: says pausing may be available or to check account settings/support; does not claim it is done

text: How do I contact a human agent?
key_points: explains how to reach a person (chat/phone/email via the contact page) without inventing specific numbers

text: Do you have a student discount?
key_points: does not assert a specific discount as fact; suggests checking offers or asking support
